title: Plan executable P2-001 deterministic analytics verification
businessObjective: Prepare a bounded local deterministic analytics-calculator contract before any intelligence, reporting, ingestion, or operational capability is introduced.
technicalObjective: Define the finite V1 schemas, pure calculator API, exact validator, failure behavior, documentation, and corrected P2-001 packet; do not implement product code, schemas, validation, admission, or runtime capability.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P2-001 accepts only prepared finite numeric observations and neither obtains nor persists them.
P1-001 and P1-003 may establish future provenance but must not be queried, mutated, or redefined.
Exact verifier admission remains a separate governance action.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design specifies exactly two closed V1 schemas, one pure calculator module, and one deterministic Node validator with fail-closed malformed-input behavior.
The design fixes a finite metric-comparison request and result including current/baseline values, movement, sample sizes, bounded confidence, and non-inferential context.
The P2-001 packet is amended only to the designed static scope and names its exact future Node validator command.
The design requires separately approved exact shell-free verifier admission with near-miss rejection coverage.
Independent QA can confirm no product implementation, schema, test, verifier, CI, runtime, protected path, or historical evidence was altered.
requiredChecks: P2-001 packet scope and dependency review
solEscalationTriggers: Any live data, database, provider, report, recommendation, authorization, approval, execution, production write, payment, booking, RLS, migration, concurrency, or workflow proposal.
Any ambiguity about numerical semantics, authority, malformed-input behavior, or verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this planning document, P2-001 packet amendment, GOV-038 state, risk entry, and evidence; preserve completed records, canonical sources, P1 authorities, and runtime surfaces.
